articles.title: Kraken parent, Franklin Templeton to develop onchain investment products
articles.snippet: The partnership will focus on tokenized yield products, blockchain-based funds and institutional crypto markets.

articles.title: Elliptic raises $120 million backed by Nasdaq, Deutsche Bank as AI reshapes crypto security
articles.snippet: The crypto analytics firm plans to expand its AI-powered monitoring tools as stablecoins and tokenized finance grow rapidly, CEO Simone Maini said.

articles.title: Latest version of crypto market structure bill raises eyebrows ahead of Senate markup
articles.snippet: Some lawmakers continue to push for ethics provision in the bill as bipartisan support is necessary for the CLARITY Act to pass a Senate floor vote.

articles.title: Roaring Kitty-linked RKC memecoin crashes as developer cashes out $729K
articles.snippet: A Solana memecoin linked to Roaring Kitty’s X account crashed after its developer cashed out $729,000, raising hack and sniping concerns.

articles.title: Ripple Lands $200 Million Financing Facility to Expand Institutional Crypto Brokerage
articles.snippet: The XRP-linked Ripple secures financing from Neuberger Specialty Finance to fuel growth of its prime brokerage platform.
